notes: On 1h, %R(14) crossing up through −80 gave 10,386 entries in 2,895 separate moves. After 20 candles their edge was 0, inside a luck band of −0.06% to 0.09%. Holding below −80 gave 24,726 entries and landed at 0.03%, also inside the band. BTC, ETH and SOL each came out the same as random on their own.

Two regime results on the shorter timeframes look like signals but are not. On 1h, below −80 in downtrends beat random by 0.08%. That rests on 10 entries on Jul 16, 2022, shows at 20 candles only, and is gone without them. On 4h, the short above −20 in uptrends did 0.38% worse than random. It rests on 92 entries between Aug 4, 2021 and Sep 9, 2021.

On daily, %R(14) crossing up through −80 gave 401 entries in 122 moves. After 20 days they were 3.81% behind random entries, below a band of −2.36% to 2.97%. It is still worse at 50 candles and without its strongest stretch, 16 entries between Apr 13, 2022 and Jul 13, 2022, around the Terra collapse. At 10 and 100 candles it was the same as random.

Uptrends carry most of that daily result. Above the 200-day SMA, the cross trailed random by 3.75%, but that rests on one stretch between Nov 19, 2021 and Jan 11, 2022. In downtrends, the −1.89% gap was the same as random. BTC alone was the same as random. ETH and SOL were worse, and each rests on a single stretch.

The daily results near −20 all come from early trending runs, mostly on SOL. The cross up through −20 beat random by 2.85%, and also at 10 and 50 candles. But 25 entries between Dec 29, 2020 and Jun 8, 2021 carry it, and SOL alone shows 7.39%. Shorting above −20 did 3.78% worse, resting on 34 SOL entries between Jul 29, 2021 and Sep 9, 2021. In downtrends, all three were the same as random.

For a long DCA bot on 1h or 4h, %R(14) oversold timing adds nothing on these pairs. The DCA orders and take profit do the work. On daily, price lagged random entries at 20 and 50 candles after the cross up through −80. That makes it a reason to leave this setting out of a daily start condition, or to space DCA wider if you keep it. A short bot that opens on daily readings above −20 traded against uptrends that kept going.
